nameJa: タイポグラフィ・レッド
headline: FULL SCREEN / LIVE CHAT
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one finished Chrome Web Store listing promotional tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen. Compact landscape canvas: 1760 pixels wide by 1120 pixels tall, exactly 11:7 ratio. Not a panoramic banner. One concept, not a contact sheet.
Creative direction: bold modern editorial typographic design, like a sophisticated music-festival campaign poster. Vermilion red background, warm off-white and charcoal graphics. Large carefully kerned heavy condensed grotesk typography dominates the canvas in two monumental stacked lines. Exact text on the top line: "FULL SCREEN". Exact text on the lower line: "LIVE CHAT". Flat print-like style with almost imperceptible paper texture.
Layout: oversized off-white "FULL SCREEN" spans the upper third. Oversized charcoal "LIVE CHAT" spans the lower third. Between and partly overlapping the type baselines, a single clean flat wide video rectangle floats at a slight editorial angle, showing abstract energetic blue-orange streaming-game art with no characters or logos. Inside that video rectangle, ONE small charcoal chat overlay aligned at the right edge contains three off-white message lines, circular user indicators, and a clear input bar at the bottom. The video and its chat create a visual punctuation through the typography, not a physical monitor setup. Keep the full phrases completely legible and comfortably inside the canvas with 5% margins. The chat is a visual symbol, no tiny meaningful text to read.
Function: native live chat stays inside fullscreen video.
Avoid: room, desk, monitor bezel, real creator, cars, official Chrome/YouTube logos, glossy 3D, glassmorphism, gradients, feature labels, graphs, store status/award claims, watermark. Large, crisp, striking at 440 x 280 pixels.
conceptNote: 赤いポスターに大きな白黒のタイプを組み、中央のゲーム映像と入力欄付きチャットで機能を伝える。
